rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for creating a list or stating its items one by one.

example.english: I’ll list the things we need to bring for this trip.
example.traditional: 我幫你列出今次旅行要帶嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 lit6 ceot1 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 ge3 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an itemized list or checklist.

example.english: Remember to buy things one by one according to the list.
example.traditional: 你記得跟住張清單逐樣買嘢呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 gan1 zyu6 zoeng1 cing1 daan1 zuk6 joeng6 maai5 je5 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a list or roster of people, names, or candidates.

example.english: We have posted the list of selected candidates at the entrance.
example.traditional: 我哋已經將入選者嘅名單貼喺門口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 jap6 syun2 ze2 ge3 ming4 daan1 tip3 hai2 mun4 hau2
